content: Amnun d Tamar
Imsar awarni aya, aqa Abcalum, mmis n Dawud, tuɣa ɣares ict n učmas dayes aẓri, qqaren as Tamar, uca Amnun, mmis n Dawud, iɛceq i-tt.
Amnun tuɣa icḍen aṭṭas ařami ihřec x ssibbet n učmas Tamar, maɣar nettat tuɣa d taɛzarect, uca tuɣa war izemmar di tiṭṭawin n Amnun ad as igg ca.
Amnun tuɣa ɣares ijj n umeddukkeř qqaren ass Yunadab, ijj n mmis n Cimɛa, umas n Dawud. Yunadab tuɣa d ijj n weryaz d aḥraymi aṭṭas.
Netta inna as: “Mayemmi tceḍned ammu zi tuffut ař tuffut, cek, mmis n ujeǧid? Ma war texsed cek ad ayi t tɛawded?” Amnun yarra-dd xas: “Necc ɛecqeɣ Tamar, učmas n uma Abcalum.”

Inna as Yunadab: “Zzeř di qama u egg ixef nnec theřced. Mařa xenni yusa-dd babac, ḥima ad xak issijj, ini as: ‘Ejj učma Tamar ad ɣari dd-tas maḥend ad ayi tewc macca u ad tessewjed macca zzat i tiṭṭawin inu, ḥima ad ẓarɣ, ad cceɣ zeg ufus nnes.’”

Amnun izzeř din, issniɛmiř ihřec. Umi dd-yusa ujeǧid, ḥima ad xas issijj, inna Amnun i ujeǧid: “Ejj ad dd-tas učma Tamar maḥend nettat ad ayi tessewjed tnayen n tɣaryiṭatin u necc ad tent cceɣ zeg ufus nnes.”
Dawud issekk ijj ɣar Tamar, di taddart nnes, ḥima ad as inna: “Ruḥ ɣar taddart n umam Amnun u sewjed as macca.”
Tamar tuyur ɣar taddart n umas Amnun wenni din izzřen di qama. Nettat teksi arecti, teggʷa t u tessewjed tiɣaryiṭatin zzat i tiṭṭawin nnes uca teggʷa tiɣaryiṭatin.
Nettat teksi marmita teggid-i-tt zzates, maca netta yugi ad icc. Xenni inna Amnun: “Ejj ad xafi ffɣen marra!” U marra ffɣen xas.
Xenni inna Amnun i Tamar: “Awi-dd macca deg wexxam, ḥima ad cceɣ zeg ufus nnem.” U Tamar teksi tiɣaryiṭatin i tuɣa tegga u tiwyi tent i umas Amnun deg wexxam.
Nettat tessiẓẓwiḍ i-tent s ufus nnes ɣares maḥend ad icc. Netta iṭṭef i-tt, inna as: “As-dd, ṭṭeṣ ɣari, učma!”
Maca nettat tenna as: “Lla, a uma, war d ayi ssexsari ca, maɣar ammu war ittwagg di Israil. War ttegg ca řefḍiḥet-a!
Mani ɣa uyureɣ di řefḍiḥet inu? U cek, cek ad tiřid d ijjen zeg ibuhařiyyen di Israil. Siweř maca ak-d ujeǧid, minzi netta war d ayi itteṭṭef xak.”
Maca Amnun war ixs ca ad ɣares iseř, maca ijhed xas uca issbehdeř i-tt, iṭṭeṣ akides.
Daweḥda nnes iɛiff i-tt s yijj n uɛiffi d ameqqran aṭṭas, minzi aɛiffi i zi tt iɛiff, tuɣa-t d tameqqrant x tayri i zi tuɣa tt iɛceq. Amnun inna as: “Kkar, aggʷej!”
Xenni inna as: “War din řesbab maḥend ad ayi tessekked. Tuɛeffna-ya ad tiři ɛad d řɛib d ameqqran x min d ayi teggid.” Netta maca war ixs ad ɣares iseř.
Iřaɣa x umsexxar nnes wenni i xas ittsexxaren, inna as: “Sekk ta xafi ɣar barra u belleɛ tawwart awarni as!”
Nettat tuɣa xas arruḍ s ifassen d iziraren, maɣar ammu i yarḍent yessis n ujeǧid min ɣa kkent d tiɛzariyyin. Amsexxar nnes yiwyi tt ɣar barra, ibelleɛ tawwart awarni as.
Tamar tzuzzar iɣɣeḍ x uzeǧif nnes u tcarreg arruḍ s ifassen d iziraren i tyarḍ, tessars ifassen nnes x uzeǧif nnes, am tuyur tesɣuyyu.
Umas Abcalum isseqsa tt: “Ma tuɣa umam Amnun akidem? Řexxu xenni, učma, susem, netta d umam. War d am itteqqes bu řḥař!” U Tamar teqqim weḥḥdes di taddart n umas Abcalum.
Řami isřa ujeǧid Dawud x marra timesřayin-a, idweř ixeyyeq aṭṭas.
Abcalum war issiweř ɛad ak-d Amnun, war iǧi di tcuni uřa di tuɛeffna, maɣar Abcalum iɛiff Amnun minzi wanita tuɣa issbehdeř učmas Tamar.
Ittwaneɣ Amnun zi Abcalum
Awarni řami ɛdun tnayen n iseggʷusa munen, imsar, aqa Abcalum tuɣa ɣares irewwan di Baɛl-Ḥaṣur nni iǧan ɣar Ifrayim u Abcalum iɛarḍ marra arraw n ujeǧid.
Yuyur Abcalum ɣar ujeǧid, inna: “Xzar, amsexxar nnec ɣares irewwan! Ejj ujeǧid s marra imsexxaren nnes ad uyuren ak-d umsexxar nnec.”
Maca ajeǧid yarra-dd x Abcalum: “LLa, a mmi, ejj aneɣ war dd-nettis marra, ḥima war xak nᵉttegg ddqeř!” Netta izeyyar xas, maca netta war ixs akides yuyur, maca waxxa amenni ibarek i-t.
Xenni inna Abcalum: “Mařa lla, ejj uma Amnun ad kidneɣ yuyur!” Ajeǧid inna as: “Mayemmi akidek i ɣa yuyur?”
Umi xas izeyyar Abcalum, ijja netta ad uyuren Amnun d marra arraw n ujeǧid akides.

Abcalum yumur imsexxaren nnes, inna: “Ḥḍam, xmi ɣa yarecceq uř n Amnun zi binu u necc ad awem iniɣ: ‘Wtem Amnun!’, xenni ittxeṣṣa kenniw ad t nɣem. War tteggʷedem ca! Ma necc simant inu war t umureɣ i kenniw? Iřim d iryazen u iřim d ayt n bu-teryast.”
Imsexxaren n Abcalum ggin ak-d Amnun am mammec i tuɣa xasen igga Abcalum. Xenni kkaren marra iḥenjiren n ujeǧid, nyin, kuř aryaz x usardun nnes, uca arewřen.
Umi nitni tuɣa aten ɛad deg webrid, imsar, aqa řexbar yiweḍ ɣar Dawud, nnan: “Abcalum inɣa marra iḥenjiren n Dawud, war iqqim uřa d ijjen zzaysen.”
Uca ikkar Dawud, icarreg arruḍ nnes, izzeř x temmurt. Marra imsexxaren nnes bedden din ɣares s warruḍ nsen icarrgen.

Maca Yunadab, mmis n Cimɛa, umas n Dawud, issiweř, inna: “Ittxeṣṣa i sidi inu war ittɣiř deg ixef nnes, aqa nɣin marra iḥudriyyen, iḥenjiren n ujeǧid. Amnun waha i ittwanɣen, maɣar Abcalum igga aya di řbař nnes zeg wass i di issxarreg wanita učmas Tamar.
Ejj sidi inu, ajeǧid, war d as ittɣimi řḥař řexxu, ad yini: ‘Marra arraw n ujeǧid ttwanɣen!’, maɣar Amnun waha immut.”
Abcalum tuɣa yarweř. Uca amsexxar wenni ittɛessan, issgeɛɛed tamuɣři nnes, u xzar, aqa iwdan aṭṭas usin-dd zeg webrid i iǧan awarni as, zeg uɣezdis n wedrar.
Xenni inna Yunadab i ujeǧid: “Xzar, arraw n ujeǧid i dd-ttasen. Aqa imsar am mammec inna umsexxar nnec.”
Uca imsar umi ikemmeř awař nnes, aqa xeḍren-dd arraw n ujeǧid. Nitni ssgeɛɛden tmijja nsen, run. Uřa d ajeǧid d marra imsexxaren nnes ksin deg imeṭṭawen.
Abcalum tuɣa yarweř, yuyur ɣar Talmay, mmis n Ɛammixur, ajeǧid n Jacur. Dawud icḍen x mmis marra ussan.
Abcalum tuɣa yarweř, yuyur ɣar Jacur. Netta iqqim dinni třata n iseggʷusa.
Aya issbedd ajeǧid Dawud maḥend ad iffeɣ i umenɣi ak-d Abcalum, maɣar netta issɛezza ixef nnes zi jjihet n řmewt n Amnun, maɣar wanita aqa immut.
